items.label: UNC hoops & recruiting
items.text: Heels won their exhibition 88-70 over USC; Malone is chasing top-five 2027 wing Demarcus Henry, who decides by Oct 30.

items.label: Scores
items.text: Avalanche 3, Stars 2 in Dallas Tuesday; the two meet again tonight.

items.label: Pro pickleball & PDGA
items.text: Anna Leigh Waters swept the PPA Chicago Cup for her 200th tour title; Calvin Heimburg (MPO) and Holyn Handley (FPO) took USDGC.

items.label: World & politics
items.text: Iran ramps up Hormuz shipping attacks ahead of the midterms; Houthis hit an Aramco office as Riyadh downs a missile; Supreme Court takes up DOGE records case.

items.label: Denver & Wheat Ridge
items.text: First hard freeze of the season expected Thursday night (near 27°F), with mountain snow north of I-70 before a sunny, warm weekend.
